blurb: Hook's Landing operates sportfishing vessels offering open party and private charter trips targeting species like rockfish, whitefish, lingcod, halibut, yellowtail, and white seabass. Trips range from half-day, full-day, twilight, overnight, and multi-day excursions. The boats have galleys with hot food and cold beverages, and the crew assists anglers of all experience levels.
extraNote: All charters require a 50% deposit · Fuel surcharge may apply · Prices subject to change at any time · Hook's Landing dock at 3600 Cabezone Cir. Suite 115 Oxnard, CA 93035
